query: INSERT INTO staff_schedules (org_id, employee_id, work_shift_id, day_of_week, effective_from, effective_to, branch_id) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM staff_schedules WHERE employee_id = $2 AND day_of_week = $4 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= $5) AND ($6::date IS NULL OR effective_from <= $6))
